text: F.No. A-12012/2/2021-ESTABLISHMENT-D Government of India Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Establishment-D: Group D, R&I Section) Office Memorandum Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi, Dated 04.08.2023 Subject: Uploading of minutes of meeting on 21.07.2023 of the Compassionate Appointment Committee and marks allotted by the Committee to the applicants for appointment to 5 posts of Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) on compassionate grounds in Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) - reg. The undersigned is directed to say that the Committee of this Department, which has been constituted to consider the compassionate appointment applications for recommending candidates to fill up vacant posts of MTS in DPIIT under compassionate quota, in its meeting on 21.07.2023 (minutes of the meeting attached), has allotted marks to each of the applicants on the basis of information furnished by the applicants, the service records of the deceased government servant, and the criteria of DPIIT (uploaded at https://dpiit .gov.in/publications/recruitment-rules), for considering compassionate appointment applications (marksheet as Annexure-B enclosed). On the basis of marks obtained by the applicants, the Committee has recommended following 5 applicants for appointment to 5 vacant posts of Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) in DPIIT against compassionate quota, in the following order:- i) Smt. Shashiwala Kumari (SI. No. 34 in the marksheet), [W/o Late Shri Gaurav Anand, Ex- MTS, DPIIT (Date of Death -19.11.2022)] ii) Smt. Sunita (SI. No. 18 in the marksheet), [W/o Late Shri Manoj Kumar, Ex-MTS, DPIIT (Date of Death - 24.08.2012)] iii) Smt. S. Premavathy (SI. No. 36 in the marksheet), [W/o late Shri Shankar, Ex-LDC, Deputy Salt Commissioner Office, Chennai (Date of Death - 25.04.2008)] iv) Shri Sunny Kumar (SI. No. 35 in the marksheet), [D/o late Shri Harsaran, Ex-MTS, DPIIT, (Dated of Death - 31.12.2012) 2. The recommendation of the Committee has been accepted by the competent authority of this Department. A Departmental Committee consisting of the following members has been constituted to consider the applications received from kins of the deceased employees of DPIIT to fill-up vacancies of MTS in DPIIT on Compassionate Grounds against compassionate quota:- i) Shri Narender Kumar, Director ii) Shri Susheel Kumar Kalra, Director iii) Shri P K Pattnaik, Deputy Secretary - Chairman - Member - Member 2. The meeting of the Committee was held on 21 st July, 2023 under the Chairmanship of Shri Narender Kumar, Director, DPIIT in his Chamber to consider the compassionate appointment applications, for recommending candidates to fill up 5 vacant posts of MTS in DPIIT under compassionate quota, which was attended by both the members of the Committee. 3. The Committee was provided with a copy of relevant documents viz 100 point- scale/marking system of DPIIT, Assets and Liabilities details (in original) in respect of 47 applicants received for compassionate appointment, Master Circular on Compassionate appointment issued by Do PT vide their O.M. dated 02.08 .2022, the details of the service records of the deceased government employees as Annexure- A. 4. The Committee held detailed analysis of the documents for consideration for appointment to the post of MTS on compassionate grounds in DPIIT. The Committee assigned marks to each of the 47 applications as per the Assets and Liabilities details submitted by the applicants and assessed on the basis of 100 point-scale merit points system issued by DPIIT vide OM no. A- 12012/2/2021-Establishment D dated 15.02. 2023. The list showing the marks assigned are attached as Annexure- B. On the basis of marks obtained by the applicants, the following 5 applicants have been recommended by the Committee for appointment to the post of Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) in DPIIT against compassionate quola, in the following order:- i) Smt.
